name: ENISA EU Vulnerability Database (EUVD) API
tier_rationale: EU agency (government body) with a published legal notice; P191 'Registry provider enisa: tier trusted, terms open' (A8 BR2).
tier_reviewer: batch p3-G08-1 (council-1 A8 definitions; chair files P191/P354/P355)

reliability.justification: EU aggregation of CNA/CVE records with ENISA's own EUVD ids, vendor advisory relays and an exploited-since flag; it relays upstream data rather than observing it.

euvd.title: EUVD API: /api/enisaid?id={CVE or EUVD id}, /api/search?text=&size<=10

terms.quote: Reproduction of ENISA material published on this website is authorized, provided the source is acknowledged, unless it is stated otherwise.

euvd.notes: P191: per-CVE calls under the CVE fan-out rule (P183); max 1 MB per response, truncation = ERROR; EUVD ids are aliases only; the exploited flag goes to 'exploited' with source 'euvd'. 404 {"error":"EUVD not found"} = documented absence. Acknowledgement 'Source: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA), EU Vulnerability Database (EUVD).' (notice euvd_enisa).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G08-1 (P191). No rate limit is published; the module keeps 1 request/s and a 1,000/day politeness budget.
